# DataGridChange

`Flare.Components.DataGridChange`

What changed in a DataGridContext, as a bit mask. Raised by Changed and matched against FlareDataGridControl<TItem>.Observes so a control re-renders only for the changes it actually shows. Reading the changed values is a separate, explicit step: the notification carries flags rather than a state snapshot so a burst of keystrokes in a filter box costs no allocation.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | Nothing changed. |
| `Sort` | `1` | The sort stack changed (a column was sorted, re-sorted or unsorted). |
| `Filter` | `2` | A column filter, the quick filter or the advanced filter tree changed. |
| `Page` | `4` | The current page or the page size changed. |
| `Columns` | `8` | The column set changed: registration, visibility, display order or width. |
| `Selection` | `16` | The selected rows changed. |
| `Grouping` | `32` | The group-by keys changed. |
| `Data` | `64` | The rows or the total row count changed (a provider load, a refresh, new Items). |
| `Editing` | `128` | A row or cell entered, left or committed edit mode. |
| `All` | `255` | Every change kind. The default for a control that does not narrow its interest. |
